desc:
🚌 A bus with legs… and a BIG appetite. 🕷️

Welcome to BUS EATER! Turn into a monstrous Spider Bus and chase down your next snack. The whole town is your buffet! 🍴🏙️

🕷️ Transform into a spider bus!
🏃 Catch people to earn XP!
🔧 Upgrade your ride and become stronger!
🔓 Unlock new Bus Eaters!

👍 Enjoying the chaos? LIKE & FAVORITE for more updates!
